messages.text: For a Semiconductor use case involving RFIC validation, where would Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

No passage explicitly names an “RFIC validation” workflow, but the supported placement is: **Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer sit in the lab test-execution and validation-measurement part of the workflow, under automation/orchestration if used, not as the whole workflow by themselves.** A Virtual tester workflow spans **implementation → test → debug → validation** [13][15], and the workflow scope can include **end-to-end test execution** plus integration with **lab equipment interfaces, logs, and analysis pipelines** [17].
| Workflow stage | Where Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer fit | Roles |
|---|---|---|
| Test setup / execution | The signal generator is the RF stimulus source connected to the DUT. In receiver-style tests, R&S SMW200A is used in the general receiver test setup and generates the NR uplink wanted signal; it can also generate an NR interferer or CW interferer through a second RF path [34]. In transmitter intermodulation testing, SMW200A is used as the interferer source [27]. |
| Test setup / execution | The analyzer is the RF measurement receiver connected to the DUT output or emission port. A complete transmitter test setup uses an R&S FSW spectrum analyzer to execute measurements [27], and receiver spurious emissions test case 7.6 needs a signal and spectrum analyzer such as R&S FSW [33][34]. |
| Validation measurement | The analyzer produces the measured evidence for pass/fail-style validation metrics. The covered transmitter measurements include output power, frequency error, modulation quality/EVM, time alignment error, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, SEM/OBUE, spurious emissions, and transmitter intermodulation [29]. 5G NR mode is used for output power, frequency error, modulation quality, TAE, transmit ON/OFF power, ACLR, and SEM, while spectrum mode is used for OBW and transmitter spurious emissions [31]. |
| Automation / debug loop | These instruments can be remotely controlled as part of automated test execution. R&S SMW200A supports remote control via GPIB, Ethernet/LAN, USB, and RS-232, with SCPI or compatible command sets [7]. R&S instruments in the receiver-test application use SCPI command sequences over GPIB, RS-232, USB, or Ethernet [37]. Python packages and R&S QuickStep can automate 3GPP transmitter and receiver test cases into scripts or test plans [28][40]. |
【推論】For an RFIC validation use case, the signal generator would normally sit before the DUT as the controlled RF stimulus/interferer source, while the signal analyzer would sit after the DUT as the measurement and evidence-capture instrument; this matches the supported R&S receiver, transmitter, and group-delay examples where SMW200A generates wanted/interfering or multicarrier stimulus and FSW measures DUT outputs or emissions [27][34][42].

passages.text:
R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

R&S SMW200A › Signal routing and baseband main module
| Code | Name / description | Order No. | 原文說明 / 限制 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `R&S®SMW-B13` | Signal routing and baseband main module，one I/Q path to RF section | `1413.2807.02` | Standard baseband section；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13T` | Signal routing and baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.3003.02` | Standard baseband section；若要安裝 RF path B 需 `B13T` 或 `B13XT`；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13XT` | Wideband baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.8005.02` | Wideband baseband section；RF modulation bandwidth up to `2 GHz`。 |

- Standard baseband section：`R&S®SMW-B13` 或 `R&S®SMW-B13T`；RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `160 MHz`；可安裝 `R&S®SMW-B10` standard baseband generator 與 `R&S®SMW-B14` fading simulator。
- Wideband baseband section：`R&S®SMW-B13XT`；RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `2 GHz`；可安裝 `R&S®SMW-B9` / `R&S®SMW-B9F` wideband baseband generator 與 `R&S®SMW-B15` fading simulator and signal processor。

R&S SMW200A › Digital standards、R&S WinIQSIM2、Pulse Sequencer、MIMO 與 fading
- Internal digital modulation systems 至少需安裝一個 `R&S®SMW-B10` 或 `R&S®SMW-B9`。
- 來源列出 cellular、wireless connectivity、navigation、broadcast 與 other standards options；包含 `GSM/EDGE`、`3GPP FDD`、`LTE Release 8` 到 `Release 15`、`Cellular IoT`、`5G New Radio`、`5G NR Release 16/17`、`IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay`、`Bluetooth EDR/5.x/5.4`、`GNSS`、`DVB-S2/S2X`、`DVB-RCS2`、`LoRa`、`HRP UWB` 等。
- 來源描述 digital standards 不需要 separate PC software；但 waveform packages for signals from [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] 另明列 [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC。判斷：前者指 instrument internal digital standards，後者指 WinIQSIM2 workflow，不合併為單一規則。
- `R&S®SMW-K144`：5G New Radio，Order No. `1414.4990.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K145`：5G New Radio closed-loop BS test，Order No. `1414.6506.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K148`：5G NR Release 16，Order No. `1414.6664.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K170`：5G NR sidelink，Order No. `1413.8640.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K171`：5G NR Release 17，Order No. `1413.7280.02`。
- [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC；`R&S®SMW-K200` waveform packages 可登錄 1、5 或 50 waveforms，每台 instrument 最多 `250 waveforms`。
- [[R&S Pulse Sequencer]] 相關 options 包含 `R&S®SMW-K300`、`K301`、`K302`、`K304`、`K306`、`K307`、`K308`、`K315`、`K350`。
- Multichannel、MIMO and fading 完整規格另見 `PD 3673.1276.22`；digital standards 完整規格另見 `PD 5213.9434.22`；GNSS/avionics 另見 `PD 3607.6896.22`；Pulse Sequencer 另見 `PD 3607.1388.22`。

R&S SMW200A › 文件依據
- 來源：[[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]。
- 文件名稱：`R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator – Configuration guide`。
- 文件代碼：`PD 3606.8037.92`。
- 文件版次：`Version 06.00`。
- 文件日期：`May 2024`。
- 文件性質：configuration guide；適合查 mandatory configuration、requires / not compatible / retrofitting notes、ordering information、recommended extras 與 service notes。

- 來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]。
- 文件名稱：`R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications`。
- 文件代碼：`PD 3606.8037.22`。
- 文件版次：`Version 31.00`。
- 文件日期：`May 2026`。
- 文件性質：產品 specifications；記錄 RF/baseband performance、interfaces、environmental data、ordering information 與 options。

R&S SMW200A › 基本訂購限制
依 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]] 與 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Base unit：`R&S®SMW200A`，Order No. `1412.0000.02`。
- 原文說明：Vector signal generator；includes power cable and quick start guide。
- Base unit can only be ordered with an `R&S®SMW-B10xx` frequency option and an `R&S®SMW-B13`、`R&S®SMW-B13T` or `R&S®SMW-B13XT` signal routing and baseband main module。
- 最低配置必須包含 RF path A 的一個 frequency option，以及一個 signal routing and baseband main module。
- Step 1 RF path A frequency options 不能 retrofitted。
- Step 2 baseband main module options 可 factory retrofitted；`R&S®SMW-B13XT` retrofitting only for serial number `102700` or higher。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。

Virtual tester
[[Virtual tester]] 在 [[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 中被定義為跨 implementation → test → debug → validation 的 agentic workflow，而不是 single tool。

Virtual tester › 與 point tools 的區分
問卷第 3b 題要求客戶說明他們是在尋找 point tools，或 broader [[Virtual tester]]：

- point tools examples：better scripting、log analysis。
- broader [[Virtual tester]]：spans implementation → test → debug → validation。

這個區分表示 [[Virtual tester]] 的範圍比單一 scripting assistant 或 log analyzer 更寬，但來源未提供具體產品功能矩陣。

Virtual tester › 來源定義
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 的 short definitions 寫道：

> Virtual tester: an agentic workflow that spans implementation → test → debug → validation, not a single tool.

因此本庫把 [[Virtual tester]] 記為工作流 / solution concept，而非單一軟體工具或儀器。

Virtual tester › 限制與未決事項
- 來源未說明 [[Virtual tester]] 是否為正式產品名、solution architecture 名稱或 sales / discovery 用語。
- 來源未列出支援的 test frameworks、instruments、CI systems 或 issue trackers。
- 來源未定義 validation 自動化到何種程度，也未定義 minimal human intervention 的標準。
- 來源未說明 [[Virtual tester]] 與 [[ScriptAssist]]、[[TechAssist]] 的產品對應。

Virtual tester › 可能涵蓋的流程
依問卷上下文，[[Virtual tester]] 相關需求可能涉及：

- test idea 到 running, [[Validated results]] 的流程理解；
- test script generation 或 refactoring；
- ambiguous logs / failure debugging；
- documentation lookup；
- end-to-end test execution；
- toolchain integration：repos、CI/CD、test frameworks、lab equipment interfaces、log / analysis pipelines；
- [[Orchestration layer]] 對 AI agents 的 rules、instructions、skills coordination。

以上是問卷問題範圍，不是已確認產品功能。

Validated results › 與 Virtual tester 的關係
[[Virtual tester]] 被定義為跨 implementation → test → debug → validation 的 agentic workflow。[[Validated results]] 可視為該 workflow 的目標結果之一，但來源未提供 validation criteria、test coverage threshold 或品質標準。

Validated results › 問卷中的角色
問卷第 1a 題以 `new test idea to running, validated results` 描述客戶當前 workflow，並追問耗時環節，例如：

- scripting；
- environment setup；
- debugging failures；
- documentation。

問卷第 4 段則要求客戶定義 success criteria，例如 time to first test、mean time to debug、regression coverage、reuse of tests、fewer expert escalations，以及 minimal human intervention 的邊界。

Validated results › 來源定義
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 的 short definitions 寫道：

> Validated results: a test outcome you would trust enough to report, ship against, or close a ticket on.

這裡的 validated 不只是 test has run，而是結果可信任到可支撐報告、出貨判斷或關閉 ticket。

Validated results
[[Validated results]] 在 [[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 中指可信任到足以 report、ship against 或 close a ticket 的 test outcome。

Validated results › 限制與未決事項
- 來源未定義 validated results 的技術驗證流程、審核人員、品質門檻或合規要求。
- 來源未說明哪些 decisions must stay with engineers vs can be automated；問卷要求客戶自行回答。
- 來源未提供具體 test framework、ticket system 或 reporting system integration。

5G NR conducted base station transmitter tests › 涵蓋測項
依 [[GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests]]（01.2021），[[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 6 測項如下：

| Test case | 名稱 | 測試重點 |
|---|---|---|
| 6.2 | Base station output power | 驗證 maximum carrier output power 準確度。 |
| 6.3.2 | RE power control dynamic range | RE power 與 average RE power 差值；來源說由 EVM test 提供足夠 coverage。 |
| 6.3.3 | Total power dynamic range | OFDM symbol maximum transmit power 與 minimum transmit power 差值。 |
| 6.3.4 | NB-IoT RB power dynamic range | NB-IoT power boosting；與 OBUE / SEM 一起測試。 |
| 6.4 | Transmit ON/OFF power | TDD operation 的 transmitter OFF period mean power。 |
| 6.5.2 | Frequency error | actual NR BS transmit frequency 與 assigned frequency 的差值。 |
| 6.5.3 | Modulation quality | 以 EVM 表示 measured carrier signal 與 reference signal 的差異。 |
| 6.5.4 | Time alignment error（TAE） | 多個 NR signals 之間最大 timing difference。 |
| 6.6.2 | Occupied bandwidth（OBW） | 99% power bandwidth；測得 OBW 應小於 nominal bandwidth。 |
| 6.6.3 | Adjacent channel leakage power ratio（ACLR） | assigned channel power 與 adjacent channel power 的 filtered mean power ratio。 |
| 6.6.4 | Operating band unwanted emissions（OBUE / SEM） | Operating band unwanted emissions / spectrum emission mask。 |
| 6.6.5 | Transmitter spurious emissions | 9 kHz 至 12.75 GHz 及部分 band 5th harmonic 上限的 spurious emission 測試。 |
| 6.7 | Transmitter intermodulation | 需額外 interferer，評估 transmitter 抑制 intermodulation products 的能力。 |

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 使用限制
- 本頁的 accuracy 數字與 method benefits 來自 2022 application brochure；實際性能需依 DUT、frequency range、bandwidth、SNR、option 與 calibration setup 確認。
- 本頁不取代 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S ZNA]] 的正式規格書。
- 來源未提供完整 uncertainty budget、test limits、標準章節或 test case ID。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法一：R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A multi-carrier group delay measurement
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S FSW]] spectrum analyzer 與 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator 可用於快速、直接量測 satellite transponders、frequency converters 與 other components 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法二：R&S ZNA two-tone technique
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S ZNA]] vector network analyzer 可用於量測 frequency converters without LO access 的 group delay，特別是傳統方法受 DUT internal LO drift / noise 限制時。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。

answer.text:
No passage explicitly names an “RFIC validation” workflow, but the supported placement is: **Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer sit in the lab test-execution and validation-measurement part of the workflow, under automation/orchestration if used, not as the whole workflow by themselves.** A Virtual tester workflow spans **implementation → test → debug → validation** [13][15], and the workflow scope can include **end-to-end test execution** plus integration with **lab equipment interfaces, logs, and analysis pipelines** [17].
| Workflow stage | Where Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer fit | Roles |
|---|---|---|
| Test setup / execution | The signal generator is the RF stimulus source connected to the DUT. In receiver-style tests, R&S SMW200A is used in the general receiver test setup and generates the NR uplink wanted signal; it can also generate an NR interferer or CW interferer through a second RF path [34]. In transmitter intermodulation testing, SMW200A is used as the interferer source [27]. |
| Test setup / execution | The analyzer is the RF measurement receiver connected to the DUT output or emission port. A complete transmitter test setup uses an R&S FSW spectrum analyzer to execute measurements [27], and receiver spurious emissions test case 7.6 needs a signal and spectrum analyzer such as R&S FSW [33][34]. |
| Validation measurement | The analyzer produces the measured evidence for pass/fail-style validation metrics. The covered transmitter measurements include output power, frequency error, modulation quality/EVM, time alignment error, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, SEM/OBUE, spurious emissions, and transmitter intermodulation [29]. 5G NR mode is used for output power, frequency error, modulation quality, TAE, transmit ON/OFF power, ACLR, and SEM, while spectrum mode is used for OBW and transmitter spurious emissions [31]. |
| Automation / debug loop | These instruments can be remotely controlled as part of automated test execution. R&S SMW200A supports remote control via GPIB, Ethernet/LAN, USB, and RS-232, with SCPI or compatible command sets [7]. R&S instruments in the receiver-test application use SCPI command sequences over GPIB, RS-232, USB, or Ethernet [37]. Python packages and R&S QuickStep can automate 3GPP transmitter and receiver test cases into scripts or test plans [28][40]. |
【推論】For an RFIC validation use case, the signal generator would normally sit before the DUT as the controlled RF stimulus/interferer source, while the signal analyzer would sit after the DUT as the measurement and evidence-capture instrument; this matches the supported R&S receiver, transmitter, and group-delay examples where SMW200A generates wanted/interfering or multicarrier stimulus and FSW measures DUT outputs or emissions [27][34][42].

Virtual tester › 來源定義

> Virtual tester: an agentic workflow that spans implementation → test → debug → validation, not a single tool.

因此本庫把 [[Virtual tester]] 記為工作流 / solution concept，而非單一軟體工具或儀器。

Virtual tester › 可能涵蓋的流程
依問卷上下文，[[Virtual tester]] 相關需求可能涉及：
